rv.q: But the commentary on the attention economy and the pitiless vice of expectation in which twentysomething women are squeezed today feels glib and glancing.
But in the end, ROLEPLAY feels as ephemeral and lacking in intimacy as the one-night stands it critiques.
Just like its protagonist, the show fails to hold on to its own identity.
Roleplay is a frustrating mix of a hugely charismatic performance with a script that doesn't quite do justice to its subject matter.
